🌟 torrent-player | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Downloading and streaming torrent files on Android devices with a focus on efficiency and user experience.
✨ Key Features: • Single-Contract Workflow (Magnet/Torrent -> Local Storage -> Stream/Play) • In-Progress Streaming & Per-File Playback • Selective File Downloads • Battery-Friendly & Low-RAM Stability (Native Go engine) • Modern Material 3 Design with Jetpack Compose
📖 Summary: Torrent Player is a native Android application designed for downloading and streaming torrent files efficiently. It offers a user-friendly interface for managing downloads, selecting specific files, and playing content directly within the app or via external players, all while prioritizing battery life and low resource consumption.
